problem.symptom: every CAS-guarded Registry mutation of a legacy row raised RegistryConcurrentUpdateError (RegistryConflictError at the API) although nothing else changed the row
problem.hosted_observation: fallback_draft_retire apply (digest sha256:bec0209765a259934718f0f350aa4c0f8993af8d6d2e4dcf10261f6e30f5c11b) retired 38 entries, then stopped twice on reg-strategy-spec-collector:collector-news-rss:news-cna-202611110335-aspx:de0db520632b-c89977a36459 with transition_refused:RegistryConflictError (coordinator apply outputs on the dev host); the first alpha-template evaluation write to a legacy alpha_template row failed the same way
problem.coordinator_scan: 2026-11-26 14:30Z read-only scan of all 9,940 hosted rows: RegistryEntry.from_dict(stored).to_dict() differs from stored on exactly 5,677 rows, only by the added keys replication_success and replication_proof; no other key, value or type difference; no from_dict error
problem.root_cause: PostgresJsonOwnerStore.compare_and_set matches with raw JSONB equality (payload = expected::jsonb); callers pass a full to_dict() snapshot that carries replication_success/replication_proof as null, the legacy stored payload has no such keys, so the predicate never matches

solution.rule: services/registry/models.py: normalize_entry_payload_for_cas fills only keys absent from the payload with the value the entry model round trip gives; a present key keeps its stored value; an unparseable payload is compared raw. entry_payloads_cas_equal is the one equality rule for both stores
solution.postgres: services/registry/pg_store.py: PostgresRegistryStore._cas_entry used by update, commit_metadata_cas and commit_artifact_state_cas. First a normal raw JSONB CAS; on a miss, if the row compare_and_set returned is equal to the caller's snapshot under entry_payloads_cas_equal, one retry is a raw JSONB CAS against that exact returned row. A write landing between miss and retry changes the row, so the retry fails; a real field difference never reaches the retry
solution.in_memory: services/registry/storage.py: RegistryStore.update, commit_metadata_cas and commit_artifact_state_cas use entry_payloads_cas_equal instead of !=
solution.committed_shape: the written payload is entry.to_dict(), so the next write of a legacy row stores the full current shape
solution.receipts: unchanged: a same command_key replay returns the receipt's committed_entry before any entry CAS; request digests unchanged
solution.backfill: none. The comparison change alone covers every legacy row seen on hosted (coordinator scan: only the two defaulted keys differ), and rows converge to the full shape on their next write; a hosted bulk write would add risk without being needed
